Subtract 329 days from 1714-08-14.  
1714 is not a leap year (divisible by 100, not by 400).  
Days in 1713 (previous year) don't matter; count backward from 1714-08-14.  
Back 329 days:  
First go back 14 days to 1714-07-31.  
Remaining: 329 - 14 = 315 days.  
Go back through months before July 1714:  
June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (non-leap), January 31.  
Total days back to 1714-01-01 from 1714-07-31:  
30+31+30+31+28+31 = 181 days.  
315 - 181 = 134 days left to go back into 1713.  
From 1713-12-31 back 134 days:  
December 31 → back 31 to 1713-12-01, remaining 103.  
November 30 → back 30 to 1713-11-01, remaining 73.  
October 31 → back 31 to 1713-10-01, remaining 42.  
September 30 → back 30 to 1713-09-01, remaining 12.  
Back 12 more days into August: 31 - 12 = 19 → 1713-08-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1713-08-20
